items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Clean head VINSON Benson -- or just a blues festival relating to blacks and their heritage

ctx.x: And that's a ritual. And they lost it for awhile and now they're bringing it back in. See, last year we had a situation at Miller Theatre here with Johnny [Hoop,] Eddie Clean head VINSON Benson -- or just a blues festival relating to blacks and their heritage, for a whole day, evening and a matinee and at night --and it's coming back again this year. That was the first establishment of it.

And then on the 19th of June here now, the NAACP sponsors a parade in the Miller middle of the Theatre, with this city of Houston and the Musicians' and Performers' Trust Fund pay for the musicians to play for this. The 19th of June.
